calculatedFields.name: Phone Empty
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) if phone is empty write "Empty", if phone is not empty write "Available"
*/
ifelse(isNull(phone) OR (phone = ''), "Empty", "Available")

calculatedFields.name: Approval Status
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) if status is "waiting-for-approval" say "Waiting for Approval", if status is "Denied" say "Denied", otherwise say "Approved"
*/
ifelse(status='waiting-for-approval','Waiting for Approval',status='Denied','Denied','Approved')

calculatedFields.name: Online Status
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) if is_active = 1 write "Online", if is_active = 0 write "Offline"
*/
ifelse({is_active}=1, 'Online', {is_active}=0, 'Offline', '')

calculatedFields.name: Name + SKU
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) add one field with name[Localized Product Concrete] and sku[Localized Product Concrete]
*/
concat({name[spy_product_localized_attributes]}, ' | ', {sku[spy_product]})

calculatedFields.name: ranking
calculatedFields.expression:
// Q Ignore: This expression was created by Q to help you author a particular visual.
denseRank([sum(quantity) DESC])

calculatedFields.dataSetIdentifier: Order Item + Localized Product Concrete + Product Abstract
calculatedFields.name: Formatted Price to pay
Avg Order Size
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) sum quantity divided by number of order reference
*/
sum(quantity) / count({order_reference})

calculatedFields.name: Order Items "Waiting for Return"
Status Not Canceled
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) name is not equal "canceled"
*/
isNotNull(name) AND name <> "canceled"

calculatedFields.name: TEST
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) build formula for dividing the number of units (or products) sold by the number of transactions (purchases) to see the average number of items per purchase
*/
sum(quantity) / count({id_sales_order})

calculatedFields.name: Full Name
calculatedFields.expression:
/*
(AI generated) first and last name
*/
concat({first_name}, ' ', {last_name}, ' | ', ifelse(isNull({customer_reference}), 'Guest', {customer_reference}))
